name: AEA RD-FRD Pattern (High Confidence)
description: High confidence pattern matches uppercase plaintext markings with our without dashes and slashes with mid-string matching prevention.

name: AEA RD-FRD Pattern (Medium Confidence)
description: Medium confidence pattern matches any case plaintext markings with our without dashes and slashes with mid-string matching prevention.

name: AEA RD-FRD-Portion-Marking-Pattern (High Confidence)
description: High confidence pattern matches uppercase plaintext markings with parenthesis, with or without dashes and slashes, with mid-string matching prevention.

name: AEA RD-FRD-Portion-Marking-Pattern (Medium Confidence)
description: Medium confidence pattern matches any case plaintext portion marking with a pre and post character like parenthesis or double quote. As seen in some typos. Some potential for mid-string matching.
